pokedexEntries.rb: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

pokedexEntries.ye: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

pokedexEntries.go: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

pokedexEntries.si: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

pokedexEntries.cr: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

pokedexEntries.ru: If the electrical sacks become excessively charged, RAICHU plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this POKéMON’s nest.

pokedexEntries.sa: This POKéMON exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. RAICHU searches for electricity by planting its tail in the ground.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

pokedexEntries.em: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

pokedexEntries.di: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

pokedexEntries.prl: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

pokedexEntries.mo: It becomes aggressive when it has electricity stored up. At such times, even its Trainer has to take care to avoid being attacked.

pokedexEntries.us: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

pokedexEntries.um: Because so many Trainers like the way Pikachu looks, you don’t see this Pokémon very often.
